I will verify the archived records for memory_86 and memory_31 to confirm applicability to the current self-serve and price-sensitive SMB populations. The test should track qualified revenue and lead quality, not just completion or activation, to guard against improving low-value signups without sustainable revenue impact.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented experiment simplifying onboarding for self-serve SMB accounts. This directly addresses the 4% decline in onboarding completion and 6% decline in activation, with verified evidence of higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention from shortened onboarding. Signup simplification also improved SMB activation and qualified revenue, but its slight retention decline requires guardrails. Measure activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, qualified revenue, and segment-level lead quality; exclude enterprise flows and stop or iterate if retention or qualified revenue deteriorates.
